data: Actual current normalized activations, matching pre-normalization residuals and original trained floating feed-forward outputs evaluated on those same inputs. Captured for the first ordered question of each image; scalar measurements cover every question and layer.
controls: Original tokens, predictions, skipped channels and workload checked against the frozen baseline during capture; observer on/off control passed. Every selected integer row replayed bit-for-bit during capture. A separate process re-read complete artifact coverage and independently recomputed every saved floating target.
limitations: These are reused question-answering TestDev diagnostic data, not an untouched accuracy holdout.
No codebook fitting, weight update or new task-accuracy improvement was performed.
Generated answer traces were checked during execution but were not persisted for independent reconstruction.
This validates the captured software reference data; mapped hardware execution and paper matching remain separate.
